why: a rule binds to a role and the role comes from the path, so an unmapped file escapes every rule
fix: move the file under a role path or ask the operator to extend gates/roles.json
agents_md: Every source file has a role from gates/roles.json.

why: the controls protect themselves; an agent must not weaken the gates it is judged by
fix: restore the control file and deliver the change as a patch for the operator
agents_md: Never edit operator-only files.

why: force pushes, skipped hooks and mutating API calls bypass review
fix: use the allowed alternative named in the message
agents_md: Never force-push, skip hooks or call gh api with a mutating method.

why: a secret in a file ends up in git history
fix: read the value from the environment or a secret store

why: prose and gates drift apart unless every rule line names its gate
fix: end the rule line with (gate: ID) or (review); the operator edits AGENTS.md
agents_md: Keep AGENTS.md under 100 lines with a gate id or (review) on every rule line.

why: decisions are found by make adr-find only when every record has the same shape
fix: use make adr-new, keep frontmatter id, title, status, tags, stay under 50 lines, run make decisions
agents_md: One ADR per decision; ask before writing one.

why: an inline suppression turns a gate green without fixing the finding
fix: fix the finding; only the operator raises gates/suppress-baseline.json
agents_md: Never weaken, suppress or bypass a gate.

why: a core returns rejections as values so every caller decides
fix: return the rejection as a value (a frozen model or None)
agents_md: Never raise in a core.

why: a core stays testable without starting anything
fix: pass data in as arguments; the flow calls adapters
agents_md: A core imports no adapter, wiring, logging or IO library.

why: only an adapter knows how its foreign system fails
fix: let the adapter return a value for the failure and branch on that value
agents_md: try/except only in adapters.

why: mutable objects hide state changes from the reader
fix: use a frozen Pydantic model or a Protocol port
agents_md: Classes only as frozen models or Protocol ports.

why: comments drift from code; facts the code cannot show are the exception
fix: delete the comment or write one '# constraint: <fact>' line
agents_md: Comments only as '# constraint:' or tool directives.

why: output goes through structured logs
fix: log one JSON event with the outcome from the flow
agents_md: Log, never print.

why: routes are found by reading decorators and carry an operation_id
fix: declare the route with @router.<method>(..., operation_id=...)
agents_md: Routes only with a router decorator.

why: Any switches the type checker off
fix: name the real type, a Protocol or a union
agents_md: Any is forbidden.

why: a flow sequences load, decide and apply; decisions live in the core where they are tested
fix: move the comparison into a decide_* function and match on its result
agents_md: A flow never compares or branches on its own.

why: a blanket or file-wide suppression turns a gate green without a fix; type: ignore is off in pyrightconfig.json
fix: fix the finding; a targeted `# noqa: CODE` or `# pyright: ignore[rule]` counts against gates/suppress-baseline.json, which only the operator raises
agents_md: No blanket noqa, type: ignore, pyright mode comment, ruff: noqa, bare ruff: ignore or ast-grep-ignore.

why: a skipped, expected-to-fail or deselected test is green without running; pytest hooks in tests change what runs
fix: make the test pass or delete it in a reviewed change; put shared setup into fixtures, not pytest_* hooks
agents_md: Never skip, xfail or deselect a test.

why: a run that skipped, deselected or only collected tests ends green without proving anything
fix: make every collected test run and pass; never steer pytest from a config file or plugin of your own
agents_md: Every collected test runs and passes.

why: a comment never needs a second line
fix: keep one '# constraint:' line or delete the comment
agents_md: A comment never continues on the next line.
what: comment continues on the next line

why: a function that mutates its argument surprises every caller
fix: return a new value instead
agents_md: Never mutate an argument.

why: long functions hide decisions
fix: split the function along its decisions
agents_md: Functions stay within the role budget.

why: long modules mix topics
fix: split into core_<topic>.py or a new feature
agents_md: Modules stay within the role budget.

why: a feature is found in one place with a fixed set of files
fix: use only __init__, api, core, core_<topic> and flow in a feature package
agents_md: Only the allowed files in a feature.

why: every decision is proven by a test that checks its result
fix: assert on the result of the decide_* or translate_* call in the same test, directly or through a variable
agents_md: The result of every decide_* and adapter translate_* flows into an assert.

why: a feature is only proven through its observable behaviour
fix: add tests/test_<feature>.py with one behaviour test
agents_md: One behaviour test per feature.

why: a core stays testable without starting anything
fix: remove the import; pass data in from the flow
agents_md: Cores import no adapter, wiring or IO library.

why: features stay separable; facts travel through a database row
fix: hand the fact over through the database; the reader decides
agents_md: Never import one feature from another.

selftest.expect: \[PY-FEATURES-INDEPENDENT\] features never import each other BROKEN

why: a changed decision needs a changed test
fix: change the test that calls the decision together with the core

why: the one-sentence docstring is the contract a reader and a reviewing agent check the code against
fix: add a one-sentence docstring that says what the function returns or does
agents_md: Every public function has a one-sentence docstring.

why: a gate may only grow; changing or deleting one weakens it
fix: add a new rule with test, fixture and catalog entry instead of changing an existing one
agents_md: You may add a gate; never change or delete one.
